nodes.name: TiO2 nanotube precursor synthesis
nodes.procedure: TiO2 nanotube precursors were synthesized according to the literature [28].
nodes.source_text: TiO2 nanotube precursors were synthesized according to the literature [28].

nodes.name: Sulfur doping and purification
nodes.procedure: The sublimed sulfur powders and TiO2 nanotubes were equably mixed in a combustion boat. The mixture then was transferred to tube furnace and heated to 500°C at the speed of 10°C min^-1 for 2 h in Ar atmosphere to avoid the simple oxidation. The obtained samples soaked in a solution of dimethylbenzene for 10 h, to remove sulfur particles, and then rinsed with ethanol and deionized water several times. In order to remove the surface-adsorbed SO4^2- or SO3^2- species, the samples were treated with a solution of 0.1 M HCl for 10 h, and then rinsed with deionized water many times. The washed samples were dried at 80°C for 24 h and S-doped TiO2 nanotubes were produced.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ti 2p peaks at 458.6 and 464.2 eV assignable to Ti⁴⁺ 2p₃/₂ and 2p₁/₂; O 1s peaks at 529.6 eV (lattice oxygen) and 531.7 eV (physisorbed water); S 2p peaks at 162.2 eV (S₂²⁻), 167.5 eV (S⁴⁺), 168.5 eV (S⁶⁺); S₂²⁻ content 0.26 At%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In 0.26-S₂²⁻-TiO₂ sample's Ti 2p spectra (Fig. 1a), two peaks at binding energies of 458.6 and 464.2 eV, assignable to its 2p₃/₂ and 2p₁/₂, respectively, of Ti⁴⁺ in TiO₂... In S 2p spectra (Fig. 1c), it is apparent that the S 2p peaks around 162.2 eV, 167.5 eV and 168.5 eV are in conformity with the reported binding energies of sulfur in S₂²⁻, S⁴⁺ and S⁶⁺.

nodes.characterization_summary: Anatase TiO₂ phase with main peaks at (101), (004), (200) planes; average crystallite size ~9 nm for S₂²⁻-doped samples vs 15 nm for pure TiO₂; (200) peak shifts to higher angles indicating lattice shrinkage.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The main diffraction peaks are indexed as the (101), (004), (200)... reflections of tetragonal TiO₂ (anatase phase)... the as-synthesized samples have small crystallite size with an average size of around 15 nm and around 9 nm...

nodes.characterization_summary: 1D nanotubes with smooth surfaces, up to 2 μm length, highly oriented growth with aspect ratio ~200.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the SEM images of 0.26-S₂²⁻-doped TiO₂ nanotubes (Fig. 3a and b), the 1D nanostructures have extraordinarily smooth surfaces, and are up to 2 μm in length...

nodes.characterization_summary: Tube-wall thickness 2.5 nm composed of 4 layers with interlayer spacing 5.74 Å consistent with treble lattice distance of (200) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The nanotube's diameter is 9 nm, and the tube-wall is about 2.5 nm and composed of 4 layers nanotube walls and the interlayer spacing is about 5.74 Å, which is consistent with the treble lattice distance of (200) plans.

nodes.characterization_summary: Uniform distribution of Ti, O, and S elements throughout the nanotubes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Using 0.26-S₂²⁻-TiO₂ product as an example, as shown in Fig. 1d–g, it clearly shows the presence of Ti, O and S elements and the S ions are uniformly distributed in the nanotubes...

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface area increases from 54.5 m²/g (pristine TiO₂) to 118.1 m²/g (S₂²⁻-doped TiO₂); pore size decreases from 5.5 nm to 3.5 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It can be seen in Table S1 that compared with the TiO₂ nanotube precursor, the BET surface areas of the S₂²⁻-doped TiO₂ samples show an increase from 54.5 m² g⁻¹ to 118.1 m² g⁻¹...

nodes.characterization_summary: Full visible-light absorption from 400-800 nm due to S₂²⁻ doping; color changes from milky-white to grayer under visible light.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Meanwhile, their UV–vis diffuse reflectance spectra further confirm the above observation... full visible-light absorption (from 400 to 800 nm)...

nodes.characterization_summary: PL emission from 525-800 nm centered at 649 nm (1.91 eV) under 500 nm excitation; intensity decreases with increasing S content indicating reduced radiative recombination.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It can be seen that the PL emission signals of S₂²⁻-doped samples are observed from 525 to 800 nm in the visible region and centered at 649 nm (1.91 eV).

nodes.characterization_summary: 0.26-S₂²⁻-TiO₂ shows highest transient photocurrent response under visible light (>400 nm) compared to undoped and 0.33-S₂²⁻-TiO₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Consistent with their PL results, it shows that the 0.26-S₂²⁻-TiO₂ sample has the most enhanced photocurrents under visible light.

nodes.evidence_snippet: Afterward, the conductivities of undoped TiO₂, 0.26-S₂²⁻-TiO₂ and 0.33-S₂²⁻-TiO₂ have also been measured, which are 1.3×10⁹, 3.16×10⁷ and 2.21×10⁸ Ω, respectively.
